status: prototype preview, not shipped and not registered in PNG_UNIT_SPRITES
generator: ChatGPT image generation (project owner, paid plan)
prompts: Generated from scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-rigs/archer.json by `strips.py prompt` (templates in scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-prompts/). Conversation A drew the master; conversation B, with the master attached, drew the damage, attack, hit and defeat sheets. The prompts ChatGPT actually ran were not captured.
licence_note: Covered by the project's non-commercial posture (docs/asset-rights-ledger.md). If this art is adopted for the game it needs a ledger family row and a provenance record under design/png-sprites/sources/ like the other generated units.
originals_note: The five downloaded originals are not committed. Only the re-encoded sheet.png and mask.png are, built by scripts/sprite-puppet/strips.py from decoded pixels (no EXIF/XMP/ICC or C2PA survives).
scan: python3 -I scripts/portrait-pixelate/portrait_pixelate.py scan: all five passed (PNG magic bytes, nothing after the image stream, one frame, within the pixel limit). ClamAV was not installed, so only the structural checks ran.
regenerations: None: every image was accepted on its first generation. `strips.py probe` reported 0 errors and, for the defeat sheet, one warning (the lying figure is 174 px tall).
